programs.name: Abstract & Surreal Landscapes
programs.description: Move  beyond traditional depictions of nature and explore more abstract, expressive  approaches to landscape. Through painting, drawing, and sketching, discover how  colour, shape and composition can capture the spirit and emotion of a place  rather than its literal form. Experiment with layering, mark-making and dynamic  brushwork to translate the emotional and atmospheric qualities of the natural  world into an abstract visual language.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own! Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes
programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided. programs.name: Abstract & Surreal Landscapes
programs.description: Move  beyond traditional depictions of nature and explore more abstract, expressive  approaches to landscape. Through painting, drawing, and sketching, discover how  colour, shape and composition can capture the spirit and emotion of a place  rather than its literal form. Experiment with layering, mark-making and dynamic  brushwork to translate the emotional and atmospheric qualities of the natural  world into an abstract visual language.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own! Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Abstract & Surreal Landscapes
programs.description: Move  beyond traditional depictions of nature and explore more abstract, expressive  approaches to landscape. Through painting, drawing, and sketching, discover how  colour, shape and composition can capture the spirit and emotion of a place  rather than its literal form. Experiment with layering, mark-making and dynamic  brushwork to translate the emotional and atmospheric qualities of the natural  world into an abstract visual language.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own! Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own! Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Ranger Patrol
programs.description: The Ranger Patrol program focuses on performance with a 200-metre timed swim and 100-metre fitness medley. It also provides instruction on assessing unconscious victims, treatment for shock and obstructed airway procedures.Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 9 or Rookie Patrol.

programs.name: Rookie Patrol
programs.description: The Rookie Patrol program focuses on performance with a 100-metre timed swim and 350-metre workouts. It also provides instruction on assessing conscious victims, treatment of bleeding, and contacting Emergency Medical Services (EMS).Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 8.

programs.name: SPLASH Swim Team
programs.description: Expand your swimming skills by practicing your strokes in a team-based environment and showcase your skills during competitive swim meets. Prerequisite: Must be able to swim at least two continuous pool lengths (approximately 50 metres) of unassisted front swim and demonstrate ability to take breaths. IMPORTANT: The City of Toronto is dedicated to ensuring the safety of all individuals who participate in its activities and services. This program requires the review of Ontario's Concussion Awareness Resources and the City of Toronto's Concussion Code of Conduct. A signature of acknowledgment is required for participants under the age of 26, or parents/caregivers of participants under the age of 18, on the first day of program participation.Visit www.toronto.ca/concussionsafety for more information on concussion safety in our sports and recreation programs.

programs.name: Star Patrol
programs.description: The Star Patrol program focuses on performance with a 300-metre timed swim and 600-metre workouts. programs.name: Abstract & Surreal Landscapes
programs.description: Move  beyond traditional depictions of nature and explore more abstract, expressive  approaches to landscape. Through painting, drawing, and sketching, discover how  colour, shape and composition can capture the spirit and emotion of a place  rather than its literal form. Experiment with layering, mark-making and dynamic  brushwork to translate the emotional and atmospheric qualities of the natural  world into an abstract visual language.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own! Materials list will be provided.

Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own! Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes
programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.    This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.
